title: Characterizing equality after insertion
statement: For finite sets $S,A\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, inserting $i$ into $S$ gives $A$ if and only if $i\in A$ and either $S=A$ or $S=A\setminus\{i\}$.
